scope: Independent review of the two frozen live artifacts, separate from native completion and model verdict
acceptance: All current wire requests use GLM 5.3/max with enabled thinking and the frozen output cap; usage is settled.
Identical source, question, data, baseline and limits across arms; no control output or operator review injected into adaptive inputs.
Required analyst, designer and exact-report reviewer tasks actually terminate, including native acknowledgement calls.
Scores, counts, spec digest, changed rows, provenance and complete report hash pass independent arithmetic audit.
Both raw and normalized return scores are dimensionless; no new dimensionlessness, systematic-risk removal or market-performance implication.
Available next observed closes are not trades, fills or proof of tradability; required window and warmup exclusions are distinct.
Any comparative magnitude or dispersion claim names the statistic or has an unambiguous qualified meaning supported by independent recalculation.
Source-supported observations and unproven hypotheses are distinct; no causal explanation inferred from a descriptive ranking.
Retaining the baseline is a valid outcome; changes must match inspected and reported specifications, not a desired experimental result.
Intermediate model errors and rejected submissions remain recorded even when the final adopted artifact is clean.
limits: A bounded same-case descriptive pass is not proof of general semantic reliability, predictive value or adaptive superiority.
No official acceptance, release, pool promotion or production-readiness conclusion follows automatically.
No extra paid pair is authorized by a failed semantic result in this experiment.
